item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Generic Log Analytics Integration
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports Azure Monitor diagnostic settings integration to send database logs and diagnostic data to Azure Log Analytics. This enables centralized querying, analysis, and troubleshooting of database activity.

  • Source: Azure Updates
